text.en:
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
AND MONTALBAN,
ISLAND OF LUZON PROVINCE OF RIZAL,
WHEREAS, under Proclamation No. 357 dated December
2, 1952, a certain parcel of land of the public domain
with an area of approximately 25,475 hectares situated
in the municipalities of Tanay and Montalban, Province
of Rizal, has been reserved for agricultural settlement
purposes; and
WHEREAS, the effective implementation of said procla-
mation requires the creation of a committee to take
charge of executing the project therein contemplated;
Now, THEREFORE, I, Elpidio Quirino, President of the
Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by law,
do hereby create a committee composed of the following:
The Secretary of Public Works and Communica-
A representative of the Department of Agricul-
ture and Natural Resources.
A representative of the Land Settlement and
Development Corporation
Mrs. Asuncion A. Perez, representative of the
Philippine Rural Reconstruction Movement...... Member
A representative of the National Planning Com-
A representative of the Metropolitan
The District Engineer of Rizal Provirce
The City Engineer of Manila...
A representative of the National Power Cor-
which shall take charge of carrying out the project
envisioned in Proclamation No. 357 dated December 2,
(1) the construction of a highway from Tanay to Montalban,
(2) the subdivision of the area traversed by this road into
small lots of not exceeding ten hectares each, within a distance of
at least six kilometers from both sides of the road;
(3) the construction of feeder roads to make these lots acceg-
sible from the main highway;
(4) the construction of irrigation dams in appropriate places
so as to provide water for irrigation purposes; and
(5) the adoption of measures on flood control.
Out of the 25,475 hectares reserved in Proclamation No.
357 dated December 2, 1952, the Committee shall set aside
10,000 hectares exclusively for war veterans.
The Committee shall from time to time submit to the
President of the Philippines reports on the progress of
the project.
5200
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
in me bor section 41 of Republic Act No. 306, as amended
by Republic Act No. 457, and upon the recommendation
of the Secretary of Finarce, do hereby remit the 50 per
cent ot the 1952 taxes on all real properties located in
the City of Legaspi on condition that all the unpaid taxes
and penalties corresponding to 1951 and previous years
and the remaining 50 per cent of the 1952 taxes shall be
paid on or before December 31, 1952.
Done in the City of Manila, this 9th day of December,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-two,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the seventh.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippies
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
